edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as _from into transferFrom when transfer is called.
msg.sender is used as the spender for allowance checks in transferFrom.
approve writes allowance indexed by msg.sender.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing arbitrary delegatecall.
Rates gates minting on msg.sender == owner or a hardcoded address.
Dismiss requires msg.sender == owner to change sale parameters.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner and debits msg.sender balance.
AddLiquidity has no access control; any msg.sender can set tradeAddress.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender and mints entire supply to msg.sender.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) to pass.
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction and addition on allowance and balances.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each transfer.
ensure calls condition(_from,_value) to enforce sale limits for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure treats tradeAddress as a whitelisted sender.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to bypass the condition check.
ensure whitelists transfers involving owner.
ensure calls pairFor to compute the Uniswap pair address used in the whitelist check.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against the sale count limit.
condition reads _saleNum as the per-address sale count limit.
condition reads _minSale as the minimum transfer amount.
condition reads _maxSale as the maximum transfer amount.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
Rates arbitrarily overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue*10**decimals.
Rates sets canSale[spender] = true, granting sell whitelist.
Dismiss writes _saleNum.
Dismiss writes _minSale.
Dismiss writes _maxSale.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length and updates balances unchecked.
batchSend subtracts from balanceOf[msg.sender] and adds to balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
delegate performs an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and calldata.
AddLiquidity overwrites tradeAddress with an unvalidated caller-supplied address.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor assigns the full supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the UNI router.
constructor sets totalSupply from the supply argument.
transfer recipient parameter used in the forwarded transferFrom call.
transfer amount parameter used in the forwarded transferFrom call.
transferFrom sender parameter drives balance and allowance updates.
transferFrom recipient parameter receives the transferred balance.
transferFrom amount parameter drives unchecked arithmetic.
approve spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping.
approve amount parameter is written into allowance.
delegate target address parameter is used as the delegatecall target.
delegate calldata parameter is used as the delegatecall payload.
Rates spender parameter is minted to and whitelisted.
Rates addedValue parameter is multiplied by 10**decimals without SafeMath.
Dismiss saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum.
Dismiss token parameter sets _minSale.
Dismiss maxToken parameter sets _maxSale.
batchSend recipient array parameter controls the loop and balance credits.
batchSend value parameter is multiplied by the array length unchecked.
batchSend loop index iterates over the recipient array.
batchSend total local variable is computed with unchecked multiplication.
AddLiquidity addr parameter is written into tradeAddress without validation.
ensure sender parameter is checked against owner, UNI and tradeAddress whitelists.
ensure recipient parameter is checked against the owner whitelist.
ensure value parameter is passed to condition for limit validation.
condition sender parameter indexes _onSaleNum.
condition value parameter is compared against _minSale and _maxSale.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter only exists to feed the transfer function's forwarded call.
Amount parameter only exists to feed the transfer function's forwarded call.
Sender parameter is consumed entirely by transferFrom balance and whitelist logic.
Recipient parameter is consumed entirely by transferFrom balance updates.
Amount parameter drives the unchecked arithmetic inside transferFrom.
Spender parameter is only used to index the allowance mapping in approve.
Amount parameter is only written into the allowance mapping in approve.
Target address parameter is the destination of the unsafe delegatecall.
Calldata parameter is the payload of the unsafe delegatecall.
Spender parameter is only used to mint balance and set canSale in Rates.
Amount parameter only feeds the unchecked multiplication in Rates.
Parameter is only stored into _saleNum by Dismiss.
Parameter is only transformed into _minSale by Dismiss.
Parameter is only transformed into _maxSale by Dismiss.
Recipient array only controls the loop and credits in batchSend.
Per-recipient amount is multiplied unchecked by the array length in batchSend.
Loop index is a purely local iteration variable of batchSend.
Total local is the result of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
Address parameter is directly assigned to tradeAddress by AddLiquidity.
Sender parameter is only used by ensure's whitelist comparisons.
Recipient parameter is only used by ensure's whitelist comparisons.
Value parameter is only forwarded to condition from ensure.
Sender parameter is only used to index _onSaleNum in condition.
Value parameter is only compared to _minSale and _maxSale in condition.
